jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Searchable

Searchable is the analytics and agentic platform for AI Search. As ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews reshape how people discover information, brands need new ways to measure and optimise their visibility across both traditional and generative search.

We help companies grow their organic presence across SEO, AEO, and GEO through a fully agentic platform that identifies opportunities, recommends actions, and automates fixes. We’re at $3M ARR, backed by top angels and VCs, and building the team that will define the category.

We’re office-based five days a week near London Bridge. For a small team building fast, in-person iteration is a real advantage — and if that’s how you like to work, you’ll feel it.

The Role

Join a small but rapidly growing engineering team, working alongside founders who’ve scaled companies before. As a Senior Engineer, you’ll shape the architecture, the stack, and the standards that the engineers after you inherit.

What that looks like day to day:

  • Own features end to end, from data model to the interface a customer sees

  • Design systems that process large volumes of AI-search interactions reliably

  • Ship weekly and iterate on real usage, not quarterly plans

  • Make technical calls that shape product direction, not just implement specs

  • Help hire and mentor as the team grows

How we think about tech: This is product engineering — you’ll take features from concept to delivery, not just implement tickets. We’re pragmatic: right tool for the right job approach. You’ll work across the full stack, and lean on your prior experience scaling backend and distributed systems.

About You

  • You have several years shipping production software and are happy across the full stack, experience scaling backend and distributed systems, and/or hands-on experience building production-grade agentic systems

  • You have strong opinions on system design, loosely held: you’ll argue your corner, then follow the evidence

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and turn vague problems into shipped features

  • You take ownership beyond your immediate remit

  • You care about craft: testing, readability, reliability and services that outlive their first version

  • You want to build something that changes how marketing teams work, and you want a real stake in the outcome

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: Competitive (DOE)

  • Early-stage equity

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • Leading parental and childcare policies

  • We’re office-based five days a week near London Bridge.

jobs.title: Account Executive – Agency Growth
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Searchable

Searchable provides the analytics for AI Search and an agentic worker that can help teams create insight, strategy and execute on their behalf.

As platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews reshape how people discover information, brands need new ways to understand, measure, and optimise their visibility across both traditional search and generative search experiences.

We help companies grow their organic presence across SEO, AEO, and GEO through a fully agentic platform that identifies opportunities, recommends actions, and automates fixes.

Backed by leading angels and venture capital investors, Searchable is building the essential infrastructure for the future of search.

We’re looking for an Account Executive – Agency Growth to help us build and scale our agency partner motion.

About the role

As an Account Executive focused on Agency Growth, you will own the full sales cycle with digital, SEO, performance, PR, creative, and integrated marketing agencies.

You’ll help agencies understand how AI search is changing discovery for their clients, and how Searchable can become an essential part of their service offering.

This is a high-impact, early GTM role for someone who can sell, build relationships, shape a category, and help define how agencies package and scale AI search visibility for clients.

You’ll work closely with the founders, marketing, customer success, product, and partnerships teams to identify the right agency segments, refine our positioning, build repeatable playbooks, and turn early agency demand into a scalable growth engine.

What you’ll do

  • Own the full agency sales cycle, from targeted prospecting and discovery through demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.

  • Build relationships with SEO, digital, content, PR, growth, and innovation leaders across independent agencies, networks, and holding-company groups.

  • Develop a clear understanding of how agencies package services, win new business, retain clients, and adopt new technology.

  • Position Searchable as a strategic platform that helps agencies measure AI search visibility, uncover client opportunities, benchmark competitors, and prove ROI.

  • Work with agencies to identify high-value client use cases across SEO, AEO, content strategy, digital PR, e-commerce, B2B demand generation, and brand visibility.

  • Collaborate with marketing and partnerships to create agency-specific messaging, collateral, webinars, case studies, and outbound campaigns.

  • Partner with customer success to ensure agency customers are onboarded effectively and able to scale Searchable across multiple clients.

  • Feed market insight back into product, helping shape features, workflows, reporting, and packaging for agencies.

  • Help define Searchable’s agency GTM motion, including ICP, qualification criteria, sales process, pricing feedback, partner tiers, and expansion playbooks.

  • Represent Searchable in the agency ecosystem through events, community, direct outreach, and trusted relationships.

Who you are

  • You are a proven B2B SaaS seller with experience selling into agencies, marketing teams, SEO teams, or adjacent partner ecosystems.

  • You understand the agency world: how agencies evaluate tools, build client proposals, manage retainers, and decide which platforms become part of their operating model.

  • You are comfortable selling an emerging category and can translate new technology into clear commercial value.

  • You are consultative, curious, and commercially sharp. You can diagnose an agency’s business model, understand their clients’ needs, and show how Searchable helps them grow revenue, improve retention, and differentiate their offering.

  • You have strong outbound instincts and are happy building pipelines from scratch, not just managing inbound demand.

  • You can run a disciplined sales process, qualify effectively, manage multiple stakeholders, and close high-quality customers.

  • You are credible with senior agency leaders, but equally comfortable working with practitioners in SEO, content, analytics, growth, and client strategy.

  • You are entrepreneurial and excited by the opportunity to help build the sales motion, not simply inherit one.

  • You care about the future of search, AI, marketing, and how brands will be discovered in a world where customers increasingly ask AI systems for answers.

What we’re looking for

  • Extensive B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally with ownership of full-cycle closing.

  • Experience selling to agencies, SEO teams, digital marketing teams, PR teams, or marketing technology buyers.

  • Experience selling partner, agency, or multi-account models.

  • A strong track record of hitting or exceeding quota.

  • Ability to prospect creatively and build senior relationships across agencies.

  • Strong discovery, demo, negotiation, and closing skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

  • Comfort operating in an early-stage environment where speed, iteration, and ownership matter.

  • Interest in AI search, SEO, AEO, GEO, digital marketing, analytics, or the future of brand discovery.

Nice to have

  • Existing relationships across SEO, digital, performance, PR, or content agencies.

  • Experience in SEO, content marketing, martech, analytics, social listening, PR tech, or competitive intelligence.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, HubSpot, Salesforce, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Similarweb, or related marketing platforms.

  • Experience helping agencies package new services or build recurring revenue streams around emerging technology.

Why join Searchable?

  • AI search is creating a new category of marketing infrastructure. Brands no longer only need to rank on Google; they need to understand how they appear in AI-generated answers, recommendations, citations, comparisons, and shopping journeys.

  • Searchable is building the platform that helps marketers and agencies make sense of this shift and turn it into growth.

  • This is a chance to join early, help shape a fast-moving category, work directly with the founding team, and build the agency growth motion from the ground up.

Location

  • London - Full time / 5 days a week on-site

Compensation

  • Competitive base salary, commission, and equity package. Final compensation will depend on experience. (DOE)

Apply

  • Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, along with a short note on why you’re excited about AI search and agency growth.

Our core values:

  1. Move Fast We make decisions quickly and get things done. Progress matters more than perfection.

  2. Find Your Lever, Then Move the World Everyone here finds the work that matters most and takes real pride in it. When you own something, you give it your all.

  3. Radical Ownership Act like an owner. Because you are one. If something's broken, we fix it. If there's an opportunity, we chase it. We don't wait for someone else to step up, we lead from wherever we are.

  4. Feedback Is a Gift Direct. Constructive. Always with care. Feedback, when given with intention and received with openness, is how we sharpen our thinking, improve our work, and build trust.

  5. Leave the Ego at the Door No drama. No politics. No heroes. We're here to win as a team. That means listening more than talking, crediting others, and being willing to change our minds.

Senior Account Executive, Germany and DACH

This is not a role for someone still finding their feet. We're looking for a Senior AE who has been in the trenches, knows how enterprise deals work in the German market, and can walk into a room with a C-suite and own it, in German and in English. Searchable is at a pivotal moment, the market is moving fast, the product is strong, and we need someone who can go and close the deals that matter most across the German market. If you've done it before and want to do it somewhere that will actually reward you for it, you’ll be a great fit.

About the Role

  • Own mid-tier & enterprise new business across the German market from first touch to closed won

  • Be the senior commercial voice in the room with German VP and C-suite buyers

  • Build and execute strategic account plans for your top target accounts in Germany

  • Work closely with SDRs and the Head of GTM in London to align on pipeline strategy and prioritisation

  • Play a key role in shaping how Searchable enters and scales in the German market, your experience and network will directly influence how we build the function

About You

We need someone who has been here before. Someone who:

  • Has closed complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals in Germany and knows every stage of the process inside out

  • Hunts relentlessly, you don't wait for pipeline to appear, you go and build it

  • Has a strong existing network across German enterprise, you know the market, you know the players, and you know how to open doors others can't. You'll leverage those relationships from day one to build pipeline fast

  • Sells with authority, you understand German enterprise buyers deeply and know how to navigate procurement, legal, and C-suite.

  • Thinks strategically, you map accounts thoroughly, identify the right entry points, and build a plan before you pick up the phone

  • Leads with insight and value, enterprise buyers don't want a demo, they want a point of view. You bring one

  • Handles objections with confidence and knows when to push and when to step back

  • Fluent German speaker, you can run the full sales cycle, negotiate commercially, and hold a boardroom conversation entirely in German

  • Brings the commercial instincts of someone who has carried a serious number and delivered

What You'll Do

  • Build and close a pipeline of enterprise opportunities across key verticals in Germany

  • Run high stakes discovery, demo, and commercial conversations with senior decision makers

  • Own account mapping and multi-threading across complex buying groups

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans for your top target accounts

  • Work alongside SDR’s and marketing team to align on outbound strategy and ICP targeting

  • Apply rigorous qualification frameworks to keep the pipeline sharp and forecast accurate

  • Bring market and deal insight back into the GTM and product teams

  • Set the standard for how Searchable enters and wins in the German market

You Might Be a Fit If…

You've carried a big number and hit it You know what it takes to close Mid Market & enterprise deals in Germany. You've done it consistently, you know where deals die, and you know how to stop it happening.

You're a strategic hunter You think before you dial. You map accounts, identify the right stakeholders, build a thesis, and then go after it with everything you've got.

You sell with a point of view You don't just demo the product, you bring insight, challenge thinking, and make the prospect feel like they'd be making a mistake not to move forward.

You know the market inside out You've spent years building relationships across German enterprise and you know exactly who to call. You don't need to build a network from scratch, you already have one worth activating.

You're hungry and humble You want to win, you want to grow, and you're willing to do the work that most people skip. We operate on a 996 schedule, 9am to 9pm, 6 days a week. This isn't for everyone, and that's fine. But if you want to be part of building something significant and be rewarded properly for it, this is the place.

Requirements

  • Proven track record closing mid market & enterprise SaaS deals within the German market

  • Strong existing network across German enterprise that you can activate immediately

  • Experience navigating German enterprise buying cycles, stakeholder structures, and commercial negotiations at a senior level

  • Strong strategic thinking and account planning skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in both German and English

  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast moving, early stage environment

Strong Signals

  • Experience in AI, martech, SEO, or digital visibility products

  • Sold into marketing, brand, or digital transformation functions in Germany

  • Built pipeline from scratch using your own network rather than relying purely on inbound

  • Experience navigating procurement and legal in German enterprise deals

  • Played a role in shaping sales process or methodology at a previous company

Location

This role can be based in Germany or London. If you're Germany based, we'll bring you to London regularly to onboard, align with the wider team, and get fully up to speed before you go and build the market out. We're flexible on where you sit, we're not flexible on the results.

Benefits and Compensation

  • Competitive base salary (DOE) + uncapped commission

  • Significant equity at an early stage in a market that is moving fast.

  • 25 days paid vacation

  • Remote from Germany - with trips to London

How to Apply Send us:

  • Your CV / LinkedIn

  • 1/2 enterprise deals you've closed in Germany, the size, the complexity, how you won them

  • A short note on what excites you about the AI search space and how you'd approach Searchable's German market entry

jobs.title: Head of Partnerships
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Searchable

We're building the future of AI search visibility. As ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity reshape how people find information, we help brands understand and optimize their presence in this new landscape. Backed by top angels and VCs, we're creating the essential platform for the AI search era.

The Role - Head Of Partnerships

We're looking for a Partnerships Lead to build the partner ecosystem that takes Searchable to the next level, working with large agencies and brands.

We're at the point where the product works, the market is moving fast, and distribution is the lever.

You'll own three distinct tracks: digital and SEO agencies whose clients are the exact brands we serve, media owners and publisher networks who have direct access to our buyers, and platform and technology partners where integration or co-sell motions open up new distribution.

Each track works differently. You'll know how to run all three.

You are the primary owner of partner-sourced pipeline and revenue. You'll structure deals, negotiate terms, activate partners, and hold yourself accountable to a number that shows up on a revenue dashboard, not a relationship scorecard.

There is no existing programme, no playbook, and no team. You're building it.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full partner lifecycle across your portfolio, from first conversation to signed agreement to first sourced deal

  • Define the commercial model for each partner track: referral fees, rev share, white-label access, and co-sell structures calibrated to drive real pipeline

  • Build activation playbooks that take a partner from signed to selling within 30 days, including positioning guides, demo assets, and objection handling frameworks

  • Identify joint GTM opportunities with media and agency partners, then work with Searchable's marketing team to execute them: co-hosted events, co-branded content, newsletter integrations, and audience-access deals

  • Run regular partner reviews, maintain the key relationships at each partner organisation, and be the internal voice for partner feedback into product and marketing

  • Track performance against clear metrics: partner-sourced pipeline, activation rate, deals influenced, and closed revenue. Use that data to prioritise your time and theirs

  • Work closely with Sales to ensure partner-sourced leads are routed correctly, followed up quickly, and tracked through to close

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in partnerships, business development, or channel sales in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record of building partner programmes from scratch, not inheriting existing ones.

  • You have specific examples and the revenue numbers to back them up

  • Deep working knowledge of the UK agency ecosystem: who the major players are, how they make money, and how to structure agreements that work for both sides

  • Experience with media or publisher partnerships as a distribution channel

  • Strong commercial instincts: you have negotiated real partnership agreements and understand how value flows in both directions

  • High agency. You do not wait for a playbook. You write one.

Nice to Have

  • Existing network across UK digital agencies, SEO agencies, and B2B media brands

  • Background in SEO, content marketing, or marketing technology

  • Familiarity with the AI search and AEO landscape

  • Prior experience in a high-growth SaaS business at Series A or B stage

Why This Role, Why Now

  • The AI search market is moving fast and Searchable is well positioned within it. The product works. The category is forming. Distribution is the lever.

  • The person in this role will not just manage a book of business. They will define what it looks like for Searchable to win through its ecosystem. It is early enough that your fingerprints stay on the work.

Benefits and Compensation

  • Competitive base salary plus a commission structure tied directly to partner-sourced revenue

  • Significant equity at an early stage in a market that is moving fast.

  • 25 days paid vacation and leading parental and childcare policies

  • Office-based, 5 days per week — we work best together in person

jobs.title: Senior Social Media Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location: London (5 days in office, London Bridge)
Type: Full-time

About Searchable

Search is changing.

As platforms like ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity AI reshape how people discover information, brands are no longer just competing for rankings. They are competing to be the answer.

Searchable is building the platform that helps companies understand and improve how they show up in AI-driven search.

They are early, well-funded, and moving fast. This is not a steady state marketing team. This is a business building its category.

The Role

This is not a typical Social Media Manager role.

This is a standalone, senior position where you will own the entire social function end to end. Strategy, execution, community, experimentation and performance.

You will define how Searchable shows up to the world.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role responsible for building and scaling social and community from the ground up, not just managing it.

You will:

  • Own and define the social strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and emerging platforms

  • Build a clear, differentiated voice in a noisy SaaS and AI market

  • Create and execute content that actually cuts through, not generic B2B noise

  • Turn long-form thinking such as SEO, AI search and founder POVs into high-performing social formats

  • Be hands-on with execution, while always thinking strategically

  • Understand how content travels beyond social into AI-driven discovery, including LLMs and answer engines, and shape content accordingly

  • Contribute to building Searchable’s authority as an entity within AI search, not just its social presence

Community & Distribution

You will not just post content. You will own where the conversation happens - including niche industry sites and forums.

  • Identify and embed within key communities across LinkedIn, X, Reddit, niche forums and AI communities

  • Drive engagement, not just reach

  • Build relationships with founders, operators and marketers in the space

  • Turn social into a distribution and demand engine, not a vanity channel

  • Collaborate with creators, operators and industry voices to expand reach and credibility

  • Identify and partner with relevant influencers and creators within SaaS, marketing and AI to amplify Searchable’s presence

  • Use external voices as a distribution layer, not just owned channels

  • Ensure Searchable is present in the conversations that influence both humans and AI systems

This is SaaS social, and therefore the right person will need to consider that everything they do sits at the intersection of social selling, brand and community-led growth.

Content & Execution

You will need to be both creative and commercial.

  • Create platform-native content across channels including video, written and POV-led content

  • Lead on short-form, personality-led and founder-driven video content across LinkedIn and TikTok

  • Repurpose core ideas into scalable content systems

  • Work closely with founders and leadership to amplify their voice

  • Co-create content with founders, creators and industry voices to extend reach and authority

  • Build repeatable formats that turn complex ideas into simple, engaging outputs

  • Use modern content and AI tooling to ideate, produce and iterate quickly

  • Test, learn and iterate quickly

This is not about volume. It is about impact and clarity.

Performance & Ownership

This is a senior role because it ties directly to business outcomes.

  • Define success metrics across awareness, engagement and pipeline influence

  • Track performance and continuously refine strategy using data and insights

  • Understand how social contributes to pipeline, brand authority and category positioning

  • Work closely with growth and commercial teams to ensure social contributes to demand generation and revenue outcomes, not just engagement

  • Understand attribution, conversion and how content influences buying journeys in a SaaS environment

What We're Looking For

This needs to be a genuinely senior operator.

Most importantly, someone who has moved beyond posting content and understands how social drives real business impact, including demand generation, pipeline and brand authority.

  • 5+ years in social, ideally within B2B, SaaS or digital marketing

  • Proven experience owning social strategy end to end

  • Deep understanding of LinkedIn and founder-led content

  • Strong editorial instincts and ability to simplify complex ideas

  • Experience building or scaling community alongside social

  • Strong understanding of short-form video, content formats and platform-native execution

  • Comfortable using modern content, analytics and AI tooling to move quickly and iterate

  • Comfortable operating as a standalone function

The benefits

  • £90k to £100k (DOE) plus equity. We are serious about this hire

  • Total ownership of a critical function

  • Work directly with founders in a category-defining SaaS business

  • Build something from scratch, not inherit something broken

  • Huge runway to evolve this into a team and function over time

The Reality

This will not suit everyone. There is high ownership, high expectations and little room to hide.

They are a 5 days a week, in-office business based in London Bridge. The environment is fast, ambitious and very hands-on. You’ll be working closely with founders and the wider team every day, building in real time rather than from a distance.

There is also an underlying intensity to how they operate. You may have heard the “9-9-6” phrase. This is not a rigid or enforced structure, but it reflects the pace and ambition of the business. People here are deeply invested in what they are building and operate accordingly.

The reason for this is simple. They have very big plans to become one of the defining companies in this space. They are already well-funded, growing quickly and building something category-defining.

For the right person, this creates genuine upside. You are not joining a steady-state marketing team. You are joining early, with equity, with full ownership, and with the chance to shape how a company at the forefront of AI search is perceived globally.

You will however have a strong team around you, including an experienced motion designer, a PR and content specialist and some of the very best engineers in the space.

For the right person, this is one of those roles where you go from running social to shaping how a category-leading company is perceived globally.

  • Lead high-stakes conversations with VP and C-suite stakeholders

  • Build and manage a healthy, qualified pipeline (inbound + outbound support)

  • Apply rigorous qualification frameworks to maintain pipeline quality and forecast accuracy

  • Skilled at running full-cycle sales processes independently

  • Confident engaging and influencing senior stakeholders

  • Strong commercial instincts and deal-closing ability

  • Strategic thinker who can map accounts and prioritize effectively

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

Requirements

  • Experience selling into enterprise brands, agencies, marketing teams, SEO teams, growth teams, or digital teams.

  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Strong discovery, demo, negotiation, and closing skills.

  • Experience building outbound pipeline and converting strategic accounts.

About Searchable

Searchable is an analytics and agentic platform for AI Search. As ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews reshape how people discover information, brands need new ways to measure and optimise their visibility across both traditional and generative search.

We help companies grow their organic presence across SEO, AEO, and GEO through a fully agentic platform that identifies opportunities, recommends actions, and automates fixes.

We’re backed by top angels and VCs, and building the team that will define the category.

We’re office-based five days a week near London Bridge. For a small team building fast, in-person iteration is a real advantage — and if that’s how you like to work, you’ll feel it.

The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to shape how customers understand and act on a new class of AI-search data. You’ll be our senior design voice, working with founders, product, engineering and customers to turn complex systems into products that feel clear, useful and inevitable.

This role starts with UX. You’ll get close to customers, model their workflows, find the real problem beneath the request and make strong calls about what we should build. You’ll also carry that thinking all the way to a polished interface. We care equally about whether a product makes sense and whether every interaction earns its place.

This is a hands-on staff role, not a layer of design management. You’ll lead through the quality of your thinking and execution, raise the standard across the product and help define the design practice as the team grows.

What you’ll do

  • Own product design end to end, from an ambiguous problem and customer insight to a shipped experience

  • Build a deep understanding of SEO, AEO and GEO workflows, then turn that complexity into simple mental models and clear product decisions

  • Work directly with customers and go-to-market teams to identify unmet needs, test assumptions and separate signal from feature requests

  • Partner closely with product and engineering from the first sketch through implementation, shaping scope, resolving trade-offs and staying accountable after launch

  • Design information-rich workflows, dashboards and agentic interactions that help customers move confidently from insight to action

  • Produce high-quality interaction and visual design, with strong hierarchy, states, responsive behaviour and attention to the details that make a product feel trustworthy

  • Prototype quickly at the right level of fidelity, using the work to answer questions rather than decorate decisions

  • Evolve a pragmatic design system that speeds up delivery without flattening the product into generic components

  • Use data, customer evidence and product judgement to improve shipped work — not treat launch as the finish line

  • Raise the design bar across the company through clear critique, strong rationale and close collaboration

How we think about design

This is product design, not a hand-off function. The best answer may be a new workflow, a smaller feature, clearer language or deciding not to build something at all. You’ll be expected to understand the system, challenge the brief and make the product simpler.

We value strong opinions, loosely held. You should be able to explain why an experience works, argue your corner and change your mind when customer evidence or real usage points elsewhere.

Craft matters here. The interface is where our customers decide whether to trust the product and act on what it tells them.

About You

  • You have significant experience designing complex B2B software and a portfolio that shows both the thinking behind the work and the quality of the shipped result

  • Your strongest skill is UX: you can frame ambiguous problems, understand real user behaviour, map complex systems and turn evidence into a coherent product direction

  • You are also a strong UI designer with excellent command of hierarchy, typography, interaction states, data visualisation and the details that make dense products feel calm and intuitive

  • You have led major product areas or zero-to-one initiatives as a senior individual contributor

  • You influence company-level decisions without relying on formal authority

  • You are comfortable talking directly with customers and adapting your research method to the speed and certainty a decision requires

  • You think in systems but resist unnecessary complexity

  • You collaborate deeply with engineers and understand technical constraints well enough to find better answers together

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and turn vague problems into shipped products

  • You care about outcomes more than ownership boundaries

  • You want to define a category, not just refine an established pattern

Nice to have

  • Experience designing analytics, data-heavy, AI-native, agentic, marketing or developer products

  • Familiarity with SEO, search marketing, martech or agency workflows

  • Experience building or evolving a design system in a fast-moving product team

  • Experience using AI to accelerate research synthesis, prototyping, content design or production workflows

  • Early-stage startup experience where you helped establish the design practice as well as ship the product

What success looks like

  • In your first 30 days, you understand the product, customers and core workflows, and are contributing to live product decisions

  • In your first 90 days, you own a meaningful product area from problem framing through delivery

  • In your first year, customers find Searchable materially easier to understand and act on, the quality bar is visible across the product, and design is shaping strategy earlier and with better evidence

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: £110,000–£150,000, depending on experience

  • Meaningful early-stage equity

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • Leading parental and childcare policies

  • Daily Uber Eats or Deliveroo meal allowance

  • Late-night Uber home when work runs late

  • Monthly fitness and wellbeing reimbursement

  • Flexibility to manage your own schedule — we care about the quality of the work

  • Office-based five days a week near London/Tower Bridge

We're looking for an SDR to own the top of the funnel for SMB accounts across the U.S.

This is a high-velocity role. Inbound sign-ups need a reply in minutes, not days, and the outbound list is long. You'll run more conversations in a week than most SDRs run in a month, and you'll get good at telling within two questions which ones are worth a demo.

You'll be prospecting into a category that barely existed eighteen months ago. The businesses you talk to know AI search is changing how they get found. Most don't know what to do about it, and they don't have an agency or an in-house team to work it out for them. That's the conversation.

You'll be one of our first SDRs in the U.S., with an SDR team already running in London. You'll report to the Head of GTM and work day to day with our U.S. sales team, marketing and leadership.



What You'll Do

 - Own the top of the funnel for SMB accounts, from first touch to booked demo

 - Be the first response on every inbound sign-up and lead. Speed to lead is the job

 - Run high-volume outbound across email, LinkedIn and phone, and get a response where others get ignored

 - Build, test and refine sequences, and kill the ones that don't convert

 - Qualify fast and consistently, so the sales team only takes demos worth taking

 - Partner with marketing on cohort campaigns, webinars and ICP targeting

 - Track your own numbers daily, spot what's working and iterate

 - Feed what you hear back into marketing and product. You'll talk to more prospects than anyone else in the company



About You

We're looking for someone who has done this before, and done it well.

 - Proven track record as an SDR in a high-velocity SaaS sales motion in the U.S.

 - Strong understanding of how small businesses buy software: quickly, on their own timeline and with a close eye on price

 - Comfortable with a high daily volume of calls and emails without the quality dropping

 - Track record of hitting and exceeding meeting and pipeline targets

 - Hands-on with a CRM, a sequencing platform and your own performance data

 - Experience with a qualification framework (BANT or similar)

 - Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

You sell to pain, not features. You find what's actually broken for a prospect, make them feel it, then position Searchable as the answer.

You qualify out as hard as you qualify in. At this volume, time spent on the wrong lead is the most expensive mistake you can make. You know why an opportunity is worth pursuing, and you walk away when it isn't.

You build the playbook, not just run it. There's no finished SMB playbook for the U.S. yet. You'll write parts of it as you go, and you'd rather do that than inherit someone else's.

You like a scoreboard. Daily numbers and weekly targets. High KPIs don't intimidate you, they motivate you.

jobs.title: Content and Marketing Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Searchable is building the analytics and agentic platform for AI Search.

The way people discover products and information is changing. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews are becoming a new layer between brands and their customers.

Searchable helps companies understand their visibility across these platforms, identify opportunities and take action through AI-powered workflows spanning SEO, AEO and GEO.

We are backed by leading angels and VCs and are building the team that will define this category. We are looking for a Content and Marketing Designer to help shape how Searchable shows up in the world.

This is a hands-on visual design role. You will create work across brand, advertising, social media, our website and sales and marketing materials. The focus is on clear ideas, sharp execution and a visual system that makes a new technical category feel simple and memorable.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop creative concepts and produce assets for paid advertising and organic social media

  • Create website graphics, landing page visuals, product illustrations and campaign assets

  • Design sales decks, one-pagers, case studies, reports and other marketing materials

  • Work closely with founders, design, product and marketing to turn strategy into strong visual ideas

  • Move quickly from rough concepts to polished final work in Figma

  • Build reusable templates and visual systems that improve consistency without slowing the team down

  • Turn product insights, customer stories and data into clear, compelling visual narratives

  • Own production details across formats, sizes, exports and channel requirements

  • Give and receive direct feedback and improve the work through close collaboration

Who You Are

  • You have a strong portfolio of brand and marketing design work for digital products or technology companies

  • You are highly skilled in Figma and use it confidently from concept through final production

  • You have excellent judgement in typography, layout, composition, colour and visual hierarchy

  • You can create high-quality work across advertising, social media, websites and sales materials

  • You can take a loose brief, find the strongest idea and carry it through to a polished result

  • You are comfortable balancing speed, quality and consistency in a fast-moving team

  • You are organised, self-directed and reliable with production details

  • You care about the message and audience, not just how the work looks

  • You enjoy working in person and collaborating closely with the people around you

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for B2B, analytics, AI or other technical products

  • Experience building a visual identity across multiple channels

  • Comfort using Paper.design for creative exploration and production

  • Experience using Midjourney or similar tools to create and refine original visual directions

  • An interest in AI Search, SEO, AEO or GEO

A Note From Sam, Co-founder

Building a new category means we cannot rely on familiar visual shortcuts. The work needs to explain something new, earn attention and still feel unmistakably Searchable.

I work across design and product at Searchable, and you will work closely with me, our founders and the rest of the team every day. We will shape briefs together, share feedback quickly and stay close to the work until it is right.

I want to work with a designer who has strong taste, enjoys making things and can turn an early idea into creative that is clear, useful and memorable. You will have real ownership over how Searchable looks and feels across every important marketing touchpoint.

Sam Hogan
Co-founder

Location

This is an in-person role based at our office near London Bridge.

We work together five days a week because a small team benefits from fast feedback, shared context and being able to solve creative problems side by side.

Compensation and Benefits

  • £70,000 to £90,000 salary, depending on experience

  • Meaningful early-stage equity

  • 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays

  • Leading parental and childcare policies

  • Daily Uber Eats or Deliveroo meal allowance

  • Late-night Uber home when work runs late

  • Monthly fitness and wellbeing reimbursement

  • Flexibility to manage your own schedule, with a focus on the quality of your work
